title: Wind Gust and Storm Alert
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherflow:obs
| stats max(wind_gust_ms) as peak_gust, avg(wind_avg_ms) as avg_wind by date_hour
| where peak_gust>15
| sort - peak_gust
description: Flags high wind gusts recorded at your own location so you can secure garden furniture, trampolines, and bins before they take off.
value: Hyper-local wind data beats a town-wide forecast; a timely gust alert prevents the classic storm-day chase down the street.
implementation: Ingest weather-station wind data; schedule hourly and alert when gusts exceed your threshold.
visualization: Chart of peak wind gusts by hour with a warning threshold.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you about strong winds at your home so you can tie down garden furniture before a storm.
